source.description:
## PROBLEM

`/home/dawid/.xtrm/hooks/statusline.mjs`, invoked as Claude Code's statusline provider, has shown transient 100%+ CPU bursts. Frequent concurrent session ticks amplify host load.

## SUCCESS

Profiled evidence identifies the hot operation. The statusline returns best-effort within 50 ms, serves a valid stale shared cache while refresh is slow, and prevents cross-session refresh stampedes. A persistent helper is permitted only if a lease-protected short-lived refresh cannot meet the contract.

## SCOPE

- `/home/dawid/.xtrm/hooks/statusline.mjs` and its tracked source counterpart
- minimal test/benchmark support only when required
- per-user cache/lock state under an appropriate runtime cache directory

## NON_GOALS

- no speculative rewrite
- no broad Claude Code or beads redesign
- no always-running daemon unless evidence proves it necessary

## CONSTRAINTS

- Collect supplied ps/perf evidence first when a live process is observable; record when unavailable
- profile wall/CPU time, subprocesses, files read, and concurrency
- renderer has a 50 ms budget and must not synchronously run slow work
- cache writes atomic; corrupt/missing/unreadable cache safe; stale cache preferred to blocking
- one refresh lease across sessions; no stampede
- preserve useful output

## VALIDATION

- reproducible timing/CPU and slow-dependency tests
- concurrent invocation test
- cache corruption and stale fallback test
- before/after `ps`/`perf` evidence when process availability permits

## OUTPUT

Root-cause evidence, hot function, minimal diff, test commands/results, before/after measurements, and whether helper was needed.

SCRUTINY: high
source.notes: Profiled locally because no live statusline PID existed and perf is not installed: cold 391-545ms wall / 286-354ms CPU; five concurrent cold calls showed five Node processes at 54-64% CPU. Root cause: cache-miss path synchronously launches 5 Git plus Beads shell-outs via execSync; per-worktree cache lacks a refresh lease. Implemented cache-only renderer with detached lease-protected refresh, shared Beads cache, atomic cache writes, stale/fallback rendering, and 250ms background command caps. Active /home/dawid/.xtrm/hooks/statusline.mjs patched from source; source remains uncommitted pending operator publish instruction.

source.description:
## PROBLEM

The Claude statusline hook intermittently consumes a core. Root cause is unknown.

## SUCCESS

Reproducible evidence names the hot function/operation and quantifies wall/CPU time, shell-outs, files read, and concurrent invocation behavior. It distinguishes live perf evidence from unavailable samples.

## SCOPE

- `.xtrm/hooks/statusline.mjs` and active `/home/dawid/.xtrm/hooks/statusline.mjs`
- read-only process/perf/strace/time profiling
- existing statusline tests or minimal non-mutating harness only

## NON_GOALS

- no source edits
- no cache/helper implementation

## CONSTRAINTS

- READ_ONLY
- first attempt supplied `ps` and `perf` only if a target PID exists; do not attach to unrelated process
- test falsifiable candidates: bd/git shell-outs, parsing files, worktree scan, synchronous CPU loops
- record exact commands, process availability, timing samples, and limitations

## VALIDATION

- identify source symbols and the call path
- report at least five timing samples or explain why runtime cannot be reproduced

## OUTPUT

Root-cause verdict with evidence, source locations, quantified measurements, proposed minimal fix shape, and whether persistent helper is actually needed.

SCRUTINY: high
